entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.7 to 30.24.0.8 (fork commit `be7ef8643780`). A corpus of 1,127 shipped queries (22 benchmarks, frozen once) across 21 target dialects (23,667 translations, no errors in either runtime) changes in 843 outputs. Exact division: possibly-truncating divisions are now written with a cast to an approximate numeric on Athena, DataFusion, PostgreSQL, Presto, QuestDB, Redshift, Teradata, Trino and T-SQL (90 outputs each: TPC-DS 24, TPC-DS OBT 22, TPC-DI 13, TPC-Havoc 11, NYC Taxi 6, CoffeeShop 5, FlightData 4, Read Primitives 2, TPC-H 1, TPC-H Skew 1, Data Vault 1). SQLite grouping sets (`ROLLUP`, `CUBE`, `GROUPING`), population and sample variance and standard deviation, and parenthesised compound operands are now expanded to SQL SQLite runs (33 outputs: TPC-DS 14, TPC-DS OBT 12, TPC-DI 3, Read Primitives 3, TPC-Havoc 1). Results published before this change for the affected queries on these engines were computed with different SQL; TPC-DS Q21, Q78 and Q83 on DataFusion returned truncated ratios and now match DuckDB (PostgreSQL is not run by the local gate, which needs `BENCHBOX_POSTGRES_DSN`). `make sql-execution-gate` reports 17 verified improvements and lists five DataFusion TPC-DS outputs (Q12, Q36, Q59, Q66, Q98) whose ratio columns now carry full double precision instead of six decimals.
